answer.reason: Genesis tells two things Ham did: he entered the ark with his family, and he saw his father's nakedness and told his brothers.

clauses.english: entered the ark with Noah, his wife and his brothers
clauses.quote: entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth

clauses.english: saw his father Noah's nakedness and told his two brothers outside
clauses.quote: saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brethren without

doubts: 1CH 4:40 and PSA 78:51 use Ham for a people or land, not the son of Noah, so I left them out.
Genesis 10 and 1 Chronicles 1 only list his sons and families, so I did not use them.
